fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { dropshipOrders: "Build dropship order routing for my home goods store on Shopify. When an order is paid, split its lines by supplier using our SKU table and email each supplier a purchase order with only their items and the ship-to address. Give suppliers a form to enter the tracking number and write it back to the Shopify order.", winbackEmails: "Build winback emails for my store. Every morning, find customers whose last order was 90 days ago. If they are still subscribed, send a winback email with the code COMEBACK10 for 10% off their next order. Skip anyone who unsubscribed. Log each send on the customer's record and mark them won back when they order with the code.", orderRiskHolds: "Build a hold for risky orders in my Shopify store. When a paid order is over $500 and the shipping address differs from the billing address, keep it out of the warehouse queue and send our ops lead Dana Whitfield a Slack direct message with both addresses and past orders. Release sends it to packing; Cancel closes it in Shopify with her reason.", marginReport: "Build a weekly margin report for my store. Every Monday at 7:00 AM, roll up last week's Shopify orders by SKU: units, revenue, product cost from our SKU table and shipping. Work out margin after cost and shipping as a share of revenue, flag any SKU under 20% and email the table to me, Sam Ortega." };
